profile.headline: Building AI Glasses at Meta
profile.summary: The moments I have enjoyed the most in my career have been solving the problems that I have found technically challenging, which is why I enjoy being a Software Engineer. While I have the opportunities and freedom in life I would like to put my career on a path where I get to solve/tackle challenging and unique problems.

positions.title: Consulting Member Of Technical Staff
positions.description:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure
Technical Lead/Mentor/Problem Solver.
Building services to help design, build, and manage Network Infrastructure from 0 regions to infinity.

positions.title: Principal Member Of Technical Staff
positions.description:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure
Technical Lead for Network Automation Organization

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer/Technical Lead
positions.description:
* Lead Ad Inventory Team, working with Business and Engineers to launch, manage, and optimize Groupon Ad Inventory.
* Lead Mobile Marketing Team in building technologies to drive Mobile Downloads
* Lead Technical Team for Displaying Ads on Groupon.
* Designed and Built Ad Service, Ad Bidding, and Ad Targeting technologies.

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst II
positions.description:
* Used Hadoop to research performance of various genome-sequencing algorithms using a shared nothing distributed architecture.
* Did analysis and research on the performance characteristics of running relational databases on flash storage supercomputers.
* Developed web applications for clinical trials and medical research projects using Java, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Apache Struts, Apache Tiles, and OpenClinica.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Worked on classified level web application for maintaining the V-22 Aircraft.
* Primarily used JavaServer Faces and RichFaces to build the web application, following the MVC pattern.
* Introduced and implemented continuous integration and test driven development processes into the development workflow.
* Initiated, designed, budgeted, and implemented the use of virtualization for testing and qualification. Was successful in improving developer efficiency by allowing easy access to testing, development, and qualification environments that could be quickly recycled.
* Designed and implemented AAA for a classified level application, leveraging Smart Cards, LDAP, and SSL.
* Mentored and advised multiple student interns in Software Engineering practices, code design, and software development
